I've gone up the west coast in a few days. The 1 (pacific coast highway) is really fun to hitchhike up. I've also gone from Louisville Kentucky to Sacramento California in 6 days flat. That was basically 2 changes of cloths a few days of spare underwear and socks, few pound of seeds and nuts, and some hygiene stuff along with a diamond cord, and some scissors. I've been having the time of my life. Found a job and am working to save up some more money to keep going. XD
